verdict.summary: The diff creates src/slugify.mjs with a named export `slugify` that lowercases input, replaces any run of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen (after lowercasing, so [^a-z0-9] correctly captures former uppercase letters too), and strips leading/trailing hyphens. Tracing slugify('  Hello, World!  '): lowercases to '  hello, world!  ', replaces the runs ('  ', ', ', '!  ') yielding '-hello-world-', then strips outer hyphens to 'hello-world'. The file lives entirely under src/ as required, and no acceptance criteria are violated.
